Revolution BJJ
2125 Staples Mill Rd
Richmond VA 23230
(804) 657-7461

Our classes use a progressive system of levels, so you can better understand whether this is the right class for you. In Muay Thai, we use an intuitive fundamentals/intermediate/advanced progression, while our BJJ levels system uses a numbered system. Read more about BJJ Levels.

6:30 PM Leglock Fundamentals (No-Gi, Level 3)
7:00 PM BJJ (Level 2)
7:00 PM No-Gi BJJ Intro Class/Level 1 BJJ

We at Revolution BJJ take our obligation to the community seriously, and we want to do our part to keep our family safe, both on and off the mats. Join us in our martial arts journey as we face and overcome the challenges we face together.
